content.value_statement: Weak prompts create vague outputs and repeated revision loops. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured prompt design, safety checks, and final prompt delivery.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses prompt goals through collaborative questions.
Recommends prompt structures such as CoT, ToT, Step-Back, and ReAct.
Adds safety guardrails for public or sensitive AI roles.
Reviews existing prompts and suggests targeted improvements.
Delivers copy-ready prompts with a design rationale.
limitations: It does not execute code, browse the web, or test prompts automatically.
Final quality depends on clear goals, examples, and constraints from the user.
Advanced prompt patterns may need adaptation for each model family.
It focuses on prompt design, not full product evaluation.

use_cases.title: Design Customer Support Bots
use_cases.description: Create role instructions, refusal rules, and response formats for public support assistants.

use_cases.title: Improve Creative Generation Prompts
use_cases.description: Turn broad creative requests into structured workflows for names, slogans, and campaign ideas.

use_cases.title: Review Agent System Instructions
use_cases.description: Assess mature instructions and propose architecture upgrades without rewriting before approval.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Basic Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this prompt for clearer results. Ask me any important questions before rewriting it: [paste prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Structured Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prompt for this task: [describe task]. Recommend the best structure, explain why, then draft the final prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Add Safety Guardrails
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this public-facing AI role with safety boundaries, injection resistance, and refusal behavior: [paste role].

prompt_templates.title: Review an Advanced System Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mature system instruction as a prompt engineering peer. Identify strengths, risks, and one high-leverage improvement path: [paste instruction].

output_examples.input: Create a prompt for summarizing meeting notes.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a structured summary with decisions, action owners, open questions, and a short rationale for each section.

output_examples.input: Improve my public chatbot prompt for safety.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests role boundaries, instruction separation, refusal rules, and checks for malicious user input.

output_examples.input: Review this advanced creative writing prompt.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies strong elements, proposes a deeper reasoning stage, and waits for approval before drafting changes.

best_practices: Share the audience, task, input examples, and success criteria before asking for the final prompt.
Confirm the proposed prompt architecture before requesting a complete rewrite.
Include safety boundaries for public, sensitive, or user-input-heavy workflows.
anti_patterns: Requesting a generic prompt without task context or expected output.
Using advanced prompt methods when a simple instruction is enough.
Removing guardrails to make a public assistant more permissive.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It improves prompts, system instructions, AI role definitions, and prompt workflows.

faq.question: Does it run commands or tools?
faq.answer: No. It is a Markdown instruction skill and does not execute commands.

faq.question: Can it help with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can shape clearer task prompts and agent instructions for Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: How does it handle unsafe prompts?
faq.answer: It recommends role boundaries, instruction isolation, refusal behavior, and other safety guardrails.

faq.question: Does it replace prompt testing?
faq.answer: No. You should still test outputs with representative inputs and edge cases.

faq.question: Can it work with non-English prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content is multilingual and can guide prompt design across languages.
